data.body: Measured the detection floor and reduced the storm to it (change 2043, commit ca67cd10ce). Method: worktree editable install (verified rebar resolves to the worktree .venv), seeds applied to src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py / reads_cli.py, reverted after each run. Results at 1 round: F3 ({} exit 0) RED 5/5; F6 (record missing ticket_id, exit 0) RED 5/5; F2 (empty stdout exit 0) RED 3/3; F4 (truncated payload exit 0) RED 3/3. Full F1-F7 sweep at 1 round reproduces the 6-round detection column exactly: F1 (lock-timeout revert) green — this test never detected it; F5 (one-shot 35s stall) green — absorbed inside the 60s harness timeout; F7 (list surface) green — unreachable from show. Unseeded: 10/10 consecutive GREEN at 1 round (no new flakiness). Wall-clock macOS (this host): 17.03s -> 2.9-3.4s test call, ~19.8s -> ~4.7-5.3s session. CI/Ubuntu after-numbers to be recorded from change 2043's Verified run (before: 12.79-15.34s across the 4 matrix jobs, run 32296354188). Assertions untouched; test not deleted.
